description: Angular directive implementing a dashboard states component with lifecycle hooks, input properties, and dynamic component creation.

classes.name: StatesComponentDirective
classes.description: Angular directive managing dashboard state components, lifecycle, and interactions.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up BehaviorSubject for state ID.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions and destroys component references.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles input property changes, reinitializes or updates the state controller component accordingly.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Creates and configures the dynamic state controller component.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the dynamic component reference if exists.
